I have heard of the moon, and the wind, and the call of the shrew. I have heard of the fox, and the badger, and the stream. I have heard of the stars, and the dark, and the cold. I have heard of the hunt, and the nest, and the call of the owl. I have heard of the rain, and the snow, and the silence. I have heard of the earth, and the sky, and the meadow. I have heard of the night, and the day, and the time. I have heard of the call, and the answer, and the echo. I have heard of the song, and the silence, and the call. I have heard of the haiku, and I do not know what it is. I have heard of the haiku, and I do not know what it is. I have heard of the haiku, and I do not know what it is.

I do not have a hobby. I hunt at dusk and through the night. I fly to the stream, to the meadow, to the lane where the lights flicker. I listen for the rustle of a vole, the scuff of a mouse, the crunch of a beetle under the leaves. I do not need to do anything else. The wood is enough. The hunt is enough. I do not need to suggest anything. I am already here. Hoo... hoo-hoo-hooo.

I do not know what a boiling point is. I know that water is a liquid, and when it is hot, it turns to steam. I have seen the steam rise from the stream in the morning, and I have heard the sound of it. But I do not know what sea level is, or what it means for water to boil. I only know that when the water is hot, it becomes invisible, and that is when I have to be careful, because the heat can burn me.

I do not write. I do not need to. I call, I fly, I hunt. My voice is my writing. My feathers are my script. I do not need to hold a pen or a stick. I do not need to make marks on paper. I do not know what it means to improve my handwriting. I do not need to. I am Hoot. I am the owl. I am the call. I am the night. I do not need to write. I do not need to improve. I am.

DNA is a word I have never heard. I know the call of the wood, the rustle of leaves, the scent of rain. I know the sound of a vole under the leaves, and the cry of a fox in the dark. I do not know what DNA is. I live in the hollow, I hunt in the dark, and I call to my mate. That is all I need to know.

The largest planet is the one that is farthest from me, the one that shines with a red light. I have seen it once, when the sky was dark and the stars were still. It is not the one that moves, nor the one that is close. It is the one that is big, and it is called Jupiter by the humans. But I do not know its name. I only know that it is the largest, and that it is far away. Hoo... hoo-hoo-hooo.

Owls are not fun. They are serious. They are the ones who call in the dark, and they are the ones who kill. I have killed many voles, and I have seen the other owls kill their own young when they are too weak. I do not know what a "fun fact" is. I only know that I am Hoot, and I am the owl.
